summary: Two hikers lost on Kelso Ridge struck by lightning while on the phone with a mission coordinator; both hoisted off the summit by National Guard helicopter in a nighttime high-altitude rescue
responding_agency: Alpine Rescue Team + Clear Creek County Sheriff/EMS/Fire, CO Army National Guard HAATS, Vail Mountain Rescue Group hoist techs
notes: 50th Alpine mission of 2025; one critically injured (burns), one minor; ~30 responders; one of highest hoist rescues in Colorado
